name: Ciempozuelos (Spain)
description: Blue field with two white wavy horizontal stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ciempozuelos (green with a wavy fess of white and blue).
history: The arms of Ciempozuelos were approved officially on 17 August 1973, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 20 September 1973; the flag, of 30 June 1994, is of proportion 2:3, a blue cloth with two white waves.
